objective: Observed public board impact, memory efficiency and tempo from the scoring player's perspective.

definitions.GREEN: Positive observed net impact above the neutral threshold under these declared weights.
definitions.YELLOW: Near-zero observed net impact within the neutral threshold under these declared weights.
definitions.RED: Negative observed net impact below the neutral threshold under these declared weights.
definitions.UNRATED: The action did not resolve successfully. No reward is assigned.

position_components: Each position component is own amount minus opponent amount. Delta is after minus before; contribution is delta times its declared weight.
known_dp: Printed DP plus active typed positive DP grants only. No inference of unimplemented continuous card text.
ready: An unsuspended Digimon or Tamer that is not prevented from suspending. Options receive no readiness bonus.
disabled: Cannot-suspend, or suspended and cannot-unsuspend. Threat units are 1 + 0.5 per source + 0.25 per level + 0.1 per 1000 known DP; this is a declared heuristic, not combat legality.
breeding: Each physical card in breeding contributes 0.5; breeding cards are excluded from battle body/source/DP components.
security_checks: Cumulative completed checks supplied by Bot C. Missing history is unknown and is never reconstructed from remaining security or attack declarations.
memory_payment: Use canonical PAY_* result steps. Traverse a steps tree instead of duplicated sibling result aliases; without steps prefer result, then named evolution/play subresults. A node's direct cost summarizes its canonical subtree and is a fallback only when no nested payment evidence exists. Equal-cost distinct PAY steps remain distinct. Independent payments must appear as separate canonical sibling steps or subresults. If no explicit evidence exists, a same-active actor-relative gauge decrease is an estimate only for explicit spend commands.
memory_resource_residual: When the active player is unchanged, actor-relative gauge change plus explicit/estimated paid cost records observed other resource gains or losses. It is separate from actual paid cost. Turn flips create neither payment nor residual. This credits observed capped gains/refunds without using nominal printed gains.
efficiency: Positive net non-memory board benefit divided by evidenced paid memory. Explicit zero-cost development is FREE with no division. Missing payment evidence remains UNVERIFIED. This is not a globally-cheapest claim.
procedural_policy: Preserve the actual signed observed components, reward and color at every successfully resolved boundary. Mark procedural commands as learning_eligible=false and decision_type=PROCEDURAL: automatic deals/draws or phase-boundary effects are observations, not learned strategic choices. Learning also excludes forced singleton choices, as enforced by the decision recorder and learner.
terminal_outcomes: Recorded separately. A winner flag alone does not make an interaction green and is not included in this board reward.
tempo: Show per-player cards in play, source depth, largest stack and completed check totals, plus per-axis leader. An overall leader requires dominance across all known axes; conflicting leads are CONTESTED and missing check history is UNKNOWN. No weights or win probabilities are implied by this dominance summary.
limitations: Immediate command-boundary measurements do not establish causation, optimal play, calibrated win probabilities or approved roadmap lanes. Later effects can change a play's overall result.
